overview.Name: GasLog Partners LP
overview.Description: GasLog Partners LP operates and acquires liquefied natural gas carriers under long-term charters. It serves businesses in Greece and internationally. The company is based in Piraeus, Greece with offices in the United Kingdom and Singapore.
